title.zh: 为南达沃省设立三名助理省检察官职位，并修订《行政法典》第1674条的法案
title.en: An Act Creating Three Positions of Assistant Provincial Fiscal for the Province of Davao Del Sur, By Amending Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code
title.orig: An Act Creating Three Positions of Assistant Provincial Fiscal for the Province of Davao Del Sur, By Amending Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5537_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Administrative Code, as amended, is further amended by inserting after the subparagraph relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Davao, the following new paragraph to read as follows:
"Davao del Sur, three assistant provincial fiscals;"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
